post.title: Nvidia's CEO Resigned. Watch What Your Brain Does Next. #shorts
post.description: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO on Nov 12, effective immediately. Reports allege an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China; the FBI and Congress are investigating, and nothing has been proven. Gus and Nell talk about the horns effect: the halo effect's evil twin, where one bad headline repaints a whole person and their whole past (Thorndike, 1920). Genius, villain, or too early to tell? Comment below. Sources: Nvidia SEC 8-K (Nov 12, 2026); Al Jazeera (Nov 12, 2026).
